description: Draft a complete U.S. last will and testament, optionally with charitable gifts to causes the person chooses. For people who want to make, write or update a will. Every name and fact in the input comes from the person. Returns the will text, a state-specific signing checklist, a plain-English summary of who inherits, and warnings to resolve before signing. Not legal advice; wills are not produced for Louisiana or North Carolina residents (gift wording is returned instead).

backstop.description: If no one named in the will survives, give everything to the causes instead of to unnamed relatives or the state. Off unless the person explicitly wants it.

causes.description: Causes that receive the charitable gift, with each one's share. Use list_causes for the built-in causes, or describe your own.

cause.description: A cause slug or name from list_causes (e.g. "cancer", "animal-welfare", "hometown", "faith"), or a short name for a cause of the person's own.

charity.description: A specific organization to receive this cause's share (required for "faith"; optional otherwise).

city_state.description: City and state of the organization.

community.description: For the "hometown" cause: the city, town or county to benefit.

custom_purpose.description: For a cause not in list_causes: what the money should be used for, e.g. "research into Alzheimer's disease".

percent.description: This cause's share of the charitable gift. Shares are scaled to total 100%.

charitable_share_percent.description: Percentage of the estate that goes to causes. 0 for none.

estate_estimate.description: Rough value in USD of property passing under the will (exclude retirement accounts, life insurance and anything with a named beneficiary or joint owner). Used only for dollar estimates.

executor.description: Full name of the executor (personal representative).

family.description: Family and who inherits the part of the estate that does not go to causes.

children.description: Full names of all children, including adopted children. Use [] if none.

grandchildren_take_parent_share.description: If a beneficiary dies first, their share passes to their own children (per stirpes). Default true.

minor_children.description: True if any child is under 18.

people.description: For plan named_people: who inherits and each person's percentage of the family share.

plan.description: Who inherits the family share. Defaults: spouse then children if married with children; spouse if married without children; children if unmarried with children; otherwise named_people.

fund.description: Only for giving_method named_fund: a foundation-style named fund that keeps giving.

advisors.description: Up to three people who will recommend grants.

lifespan.description: Spend everything within about 10 or 25 years, or keep it permanent (about 5% a year).

mission.description: The fund's mission in the person's own words.

name.description: Fund name, e.g. "The Ellis Family Fund".

use_research.description: Ask that grants follow MyLastWill.org's research (default true).

giving_method.description: research_guided: each cause's share goes to Systemic Altruism Foundation's (EIN 87-2067921) Cause Fund for that cause, which grants it to effective charities working on it, guided by MyLastWill.org research (default). named_charities: give to the specific charities listed under each cause. named_fund: create a named legacy fund (see fund).

has_living_trust.description: True if the person has a revocable living trust (a new will may affect it).

minor_money_manager.description: Person to manage property that minor children inherit (optional).

full_name.description: Full legal name, exactly as it should appear in the document.

state.description: U.S. state (or DC) where the person lives: full name or two-letter code.

name: create_will
title: Write a will
